title: Translations
confirm_apply: Apply this translation? It will overwrite your current translations for this language.
no_federation_translations: No translations available from other nodes
seed_tooltip: Load all keys from JSON files into the database
seed_hint: Click "Load keys to DB" to import all keys from JSON files into the database.
help_db_desc: what is in the database is what is actually shown in the interface. When you edit a key and press Save, the change is applied immediately.
help_json_desc: shows the keys where the database value differs from the corrected JSON file. The JSON value is the new/corrected translation. Press "Apply JSON" to update the DB, or "Apply all" to fix them all at once.
help_dirty_desc: if you modify a text, the key is marked as "unsaved" until you press Save. Only then it goes to the database.
help_seed_desc: the button above copies ALL values from the JSON files to the database for the selected language, overwriting whatever is there. Use it to discard old changes or apply a bulk update.
tab_db_hint: These keys are already in the database: they are what is shown in the interface. Edit the text and press Save to apply the change.
tab_diff_hint: These keys have a different value in the database vs the corrected JSON file. The JSON value is the new/corrected translation. Press "Apply JSON" to update the DB with the corrected value.
no_db_keys: No keys in the database for this language.
no_db_keys_hint: Use "Restore translations from JSON" to load them all.
no_diff: No differences between the DB and the JSON files.
no_diff_hint: All values in the database match the corrected JSON files. Nothing to update.
diff_count_label: keys with differences found. You can apply them all at once or one by one.
apply_all_confirm: This will overwrite {{count}} keys in the database with the corrected values from the JSON files. Continue?
apply_all_done: {{count}} keys updated with corrected JSON values.
apply_json_tooltip: Replace the DB value with the corrected JSON value
edit_before_apply: Edit the JSON value before applying it
seed_force_confirm: This will overwrite ALL translations for "{{lang}}" in the database with the values from the JSON files. Continue?
